segment.source: Fly the first armed B-wing prototype in a desperate fight to evade capture by the Empire!
segment.target: 駕駛第一架裝備武裝的 B翼原型機，展開一場 擺脫帝國追捕的 殊死突圍戰！

segment.source: Project [[Shantipole]] has been compromised by an Imperial spy.
segment.target: [[尚蒂波爾]]計畫已被一名帝國間諜出賣洩密。

segment.source: The [[Verpine]] staff will be evacuated aboard the Corvette [[Shantipole]].
segment.target: [[沃爾平人]]技術人員將搭乘巡邏艦[[尚蒂波爾號]]撤離。

segment.source: Commander Ackbar and his aides will be evacuating on the Shuttle [[Falcon]].
segment.target: 阿克巴指揮官及其幕僚將搭乘穿梭機[[獵鷹號]]進行撤離。

segment.source: Prototype #1 is unarmed, but #2 will be able to help cover the evacuation.
segment.target: 原型機 1 號未配備武裝，但 2 號機能協助掩護撤離行動。

segment.source: After the [[Battle of Yavin]] the Empire began using the Nebulon B Frigate with much greater regularity. It was superbly suited to protecting convoys from the depradations of Alliance starfighters.$ With too few capital ships to throw against the Frigates, then Commander Ackbar realized the need for a specially designed heavy fighter. He was able enlist the unique shipbuilding skills of the [[Verpine]].
segment.target: 在[[雅汶戰役]]後，帝國開始頻繁動用內布隆-B 級巡防艦。該級艦極為適合護航船隊，有效防範同盟星際戰機的突襲。$由於缺乏足夠的主力戰艦與巡防艦抗衡，當時的阿克巴指揮官意識到急需一款特別設計的重型突擊戰機。他成功爭取到了[[沃爾平人]]獨步銀河的造艦技藝協助。

segment.source: The [[Verpine]] are an insectoid race from the [[Roche]] system. Though unwilling to join the Alliance, they did commit to the project. They built two prototypes and showed Ackbar's engineers how to build more.$ The Empire found out about the project through a traitor on Ackbar's staff. Thanks to the efforts of a daring Rebel strike team, the prototypes and project personnel were saved from Imperial capture.
segment.target: [[沃爾平人]]是來自[[羅氏星系]]的昆蟲類種族。儘管他們不願正式加入同盟，但毅然承接了該研發計畫。他們建造了兩架原型機，並傳授阿克巴手下的工程師後續量產技術。$帝國透過阿克巴幕僚中的一名叛徒獲悉了這項專案。所幸在一支英勇的反抗軍突擊小組奮戰下，原型機與專案人員才免於落入帝國魔掌。

segment.source: You will fly the number two ship. Follow the (unarmed) number one prototype out of the test facility and prepare to fight your way out of an Imperial trap! A number of Corvettes and Transports will be attacking. The Transports will attempt to disable you for capture.$ You must ensure that both prototypes and the evacuation ships make it to safety. [[Blue]] Squadron will come to your assistance shortly.
segment.target: 你將駕駛二號機。跟隨（未配備武裝的）一號原型機飛離測試設施，並準備在帝國的合圍陷阱中殺出一條血路！多艘巡邏艦與運輸船正發動進攻，運輸船企圖將你癱瘓俘虜。$你必須確保兩架原型機與撤離船艦平安脫險。[[藍隊]]戰機隨後便會趕來馳援。

segment.source: Go to full throttle and set cannon and shield recharge rates to maximum.$ Concentrate on the TRNs first. Remember, the "R" key won't help you!$ Stay near the SHU Falcon until it has completed docking.$ Keep an eye on the CRV Shantipole, and intercept any TRNs attacking it.
segment.target: 全開油門並將雷射砲與護盾充能速率調至最大。$優先集中火力攻擊敵方運輸船（TRN）。請記住，「R」鍵此時派不上用場！$在獵鷹號穿梭機（SHU Falcon）完成對接前，請保持貼近護航。$密切注意尚蒂波爾號巡邏艦（CRV Shantipole），攔截所有企圖進攻它的敵方運輸船。
尚蒂波爾計畫測試設施
巡邏艦 尚蒂波爾號

segment.source: COMMANDER ACKBAR AND HIS STAFF ARE SAFE
segment.target: 阿克巴指揮官與其幕僚已平安脫險

segment.source: X-WING BLUE WILL COVER YOUR WITHDRAWAL
segment.target: 藍隊 X翼戰機將掩護你撤退

segment.source: Use the tremendous firepower of the B-wing to wipe out an Imperial convoy!
segment.target: 運用 B翼戰機 毀滅性的強大火力， 將一支帝國護航船隊 徹底殲滅！

segment.source: An Imperial convoy en route to [[Petrakis ]]is to be destroyed.
segment.target: 一支駛往[[佩特拉基斯星]]的帝國船隊必須予以摧毀。

segment.source: The priority targets are the Freighters loaded with TIE Fighters.
segment.target: 首要目標為載運鈦戰機的貨船。

segment.source: The convoy is to receive additional escort from the [[Petrakis]] base.
segment.target: 該船隊預定自[[佩特拉基斯]]基地接收額外護航兵力。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will send two B-wings escorted by one X-wing for this raid.
segment.target: [[紅色]]中隊將派出兩架 B翼戰機，並由一架 X翼戰機掩護執行此次突擊。

segment.source: Following the [[Shantipole]] debacle, rumors of a powerful new Rebel fighter quickly spread through the Imperial fleet. By the time the first Alliance B-wings saw action against Imperial TIEs, the fear was so strong that the entire Imperial wing turned tail and ran at first sight of the strange new craft.$ This mission recreates that action. It was a hit and fade attack on a convoy loaded with TIE Fighters.
segment.target: 在[[尚蒂波爾]]交鋒之後，關於反抗軍擁有一款強大全新戰機的傳聞迅速在帝國艦隊中傳開。當同盟 B翼戰機首次與帝國鈦戰機正式遭遇時，敵軍的恐懼如此深重，以至於整個帝國飛行聯隊在第一眼看到這架奇特的新戰機時便掉頭逃竄。$本任務重現了該次作戰，這是一次針對滿載鈦戰機之護航船隊的閃擊戰。

segment.source: The convoy was made up of several Freighters, some Transports and Shuttles. Escort was provided by four Corellian Corvettes. Additional escort was to have been provided by TIE Fighters from the [[Petrakis ]]base. These were the ones who ran from the fight.$ Gunboats which arrived in the midst of the battle were not so timid, though. Destroy all of the Imperial Freighters and Corvettes.
segment.target: 該船隊由多艘貨船、數艘運輸船與穿梭機組成，並由四艘柯爾里亞巡邏艦護航。佩特拉基斯基地的鈦戰機原本預計前來接應增援，正是他們臨陣脫逃。$然而，在交火中途抵達的帝國砲艇可沒那麼膽怯。摧毀所有帝國貨船與巡邏艦。

segment.source: Order your wingman to attack the nearest FRT. Then target the nearest CRV and fire 6 torps to destroy it. Switch to lasers and "blindside", (attack dead level from the sides or rear) the other CRV of the forward pair.$ You may need to break off and destroy one or more GUNs.$ Repeat this procedure for the next pair of FRTs and CRVs.$ Do not attack the neutrals.
segment.target: 命令你的僚機攻擊最近的貨船（FRT）。隨後鎖定最近的巡邏艦（CRV），連射 6 枚魚雷將其擊沉。切換至雷射砲，利用盲區（從正側方或後方水平切入）攻擊前鋒另一艘巡邏艦。$你可能需要暫時脫離以摧毀一架或多架突擊砲艇（GUN）。$對下一對貨船與巡邏艦重複此戰術。$切勿攻擊中立目標。

segment.source: NOT MUCH LEFT OF THAT CONVOY
segment.target: 該船隊已被徹底蕩平，所剩無幾

segment.source: YOU SURE DID YOUR SHARE, RED ONE
segment.target: 紅一號，你的戰果極為豐碩
俘虜普里阿姆號巡防艦

segment.source: Compare the performance of the B-wing with that of the Y-wing in this recreation of the capture of the Imperial Frigate Priam.
segment.target: 在此重現俘虜帝國 普里阿姆號巡防艦的 任務中，比較 B翼戰機 與 Y翼戰機的作戰性能。
>HM 3: 俘虜普里阿姆號巡防艦

segment.source: The Frigate [[Priam ]]is damaged and vulnerable without its TIE Fighters.
segment.target: 巡防艦[[普里阿姆號]]已受創，在失去鈦戰機護航後極易受襲。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will eliminate its last defenses and disable the Frigate.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將消滅其最後防禦並癱瘓該巡防艦。

segment.source: In a previous operation the Frigate Priam was stripped of her TIE Fighters. Except for a few small groups of TIEs and some mines the [[Priam]] has deployed around her, she is now virtually defenseless.$ General Dodonna has ordered that our Special Forces Command lead a "board and capture" operation. Your mission is to disable the [[Priam]] and then provide cover during the capture of this Frigate.
segment.target: 在先前的作戰中，普里阿姆號巡防艦的鈦戰機已被盡數消滅。除了周遭布設的少數零星鈦戰機與太空雷之外，[[普里阿姆號]]幾乎毫無還手之力。$多東納將軍已下達命令，由特種部隊指揮部執行「強行登艦俘虜」行動。你的任務是癱瘓[[普里阿姆號]]，並在奪艦期間提供火力掩護。

segment.source: A-wing [[Blue]] will provide escort for the B-wings.
segment.target: A翼[[藍隊]]將為 B翼戰機提供護航。

segment.source: Once the [[Priam]] is disabled, Commandos will arrive to board and capture it.
segment.target: 一旦[[普里阿姆號]]癱瘓，突擊隊便會抵達實施登艦俘虜。

segment.source: What if the B-wing had been available earlier, say during the capture of the Frigate [[Priam]]? Substituted for the Y-wings, the B-wings could have accomplished as much, but with fewer ships (and fewer pilots.)$ This mission recreates that operation. However, this time [[Red]] Squadron is given the task of disabling the ship so it can be captured.
segment.target: 如果 B翼戰機能更早投入服役，例如在當初奪取巡防艦[[普里阿姆號]]時，局勢會如何？以 B翼替代 Y翼，同盟便能以更少的戰機（與飛行員代價）達成相同輝煌戰果。$本次模擬重現了該作戰，而這次由[[紅隊]]肩負癱瘓目標以供俘虜的關鍵使命。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] and A-wing [[Blue]] will cover the boarding and capture.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]與 A翼[[藍隊]]將共同掩護登艦俘虜行動。

segment.source: Order your wingmen to wait, while you fire all of your torps at the FRG. Then, assist your escort in destroying T/F Alpha and T/B Beta. When the A-wing gets hull damage send it home.$ Clear the mines and order your wingmen to proceed. Keep attacking the FRG with lasers until its shields go down, then switch to ions.$ Intercept GUN Mu, then head back.
segment.target: 命令你的僚機待命，同時將你所有的魚雷射向巡防艦（FRG）。隨後協助護航機消滅鈦戰機阿爾法（T/F Alpha）與鈦式轟炸機貝塔（T/B Beta）。當 A翼戰機艦體受損時，命令其返航。$清理太空雷並命令僚機推進。持續以雷射砲攻擊巡防艦直到護盾失效，隨後切換至離子砲。$攔截突擊砲艇繆（GUN Mu），隨後返航。
巡防艦 普里阿姆號

segment.source: The Frigate Priam has been secured
segment.target: 普里阿姆號巡防艦已被成功控制

segment.source: All Imperial personnel have been subdued
segment.target: 所有帝國艦員均已被制伏

segment.source: The Priam's captain has surrendered control to our forces
segment.target: 普里阿姆號艦長已向我軍繳械投降

segment.source: Fly the B-wing in its primary role of heavy assault starfighter as you destroy an Imperial Frigate!
segment.target: 駕駛 B翼戰機展現其 作為主力重型突擊機 的核心價值， 一舉擊沉帝國巡防艦！

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will lead the attack on the Imperial Frigate [[Shrike]].
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將領銜進攻帝國巡防艦[[伯勞鳥號]]。

segment.source: A-wing [[Gold]] will escort the B-wings and eliminate enemy fighter defenses.
segment.target: A翼[[金隊]]將掩護 B翼戰機並肅清敵方戰機防禦力量。

segment.source: The [[Shrike]] will attempt to escape into hyperspace at this Nav Buoy.
segment.target: [[伯勞鳥號]]企圖在該導航浮標處跳入超空間脫逃。

segment.source: The Nav Buoy is protected by a small minefield.
segment.target: 該導航浮標受一處小型雷區保護。

segment.source: This mission recreates the first use of the B-wing in its primary role as a Frigate killer. Imperial Military Intelligence refused to believe initial reports of the encounter. How could three starfighters (and their A-wing escorts) possibly defeat a Nebulon-B class Frigate?$ The bad news only got worse. A detachment of Corvettes and "Starwing" Gunboats from the local System Patrol Squadron was also lost!
segment.target: 本任務重現了 B翼戰機首次擔綱「巡防艦殺手」核心角色的戰例。帝國軍事情報部門最初堅決不信此戰的戰報。區區三架星際戰機（及其 A翼護航隊）怎可能擊毀一艘內布隆-B 級巡防艦？$然而壞消息接踵而至，當地星系巡邏中隊的一支巡邏艦分隊與「星翼級」突擊砲艇也全軍覆沒！

segment.source: The legendary [[Keyan Farlander]] was the commander who led the B-wings in this daring attack. Can you match their amazing success?$ As you fly this mission remember that the B-wing is a heavy assault starfighter. Leave the dogfighting to your A-wing escorts. Your attack against the [[Shrike]] must be relentless!
segment.target: 傳奇指揮官[[基揚·法蘭德]]正是率領 B翼戰機發動此次大膽突擊的領隊。你能否複製他的驚人輝煌戰果？$執行此任務時，請時刻牢記 B翼是一架重型突擊星際戰機。將纏鬥留給你的 A翼護航機，你對[[伯勞鳥號]]的猛烈進攻絕不可有絲毫停頓！

segment.source: Immediately launch all of your torpedoes at the FRG and order your wingmen to attack.$ Ignore the TIE Fighters, your escorts will take care of them.$ When the FRG's status becomes "hull damaged", switch to single-fire mode and press home your attack. This will increase your chances of getting the "kill shot"!$
segment.target: 立即將所有魚雷射向巡防艦（FRG）並命令僚機全力進攻。$無視鈦戰機，你的護航機會處理他們。$當巡防艦狀態顯示為「艦體受損」時，切換為單發射擊模式並持續壓迫進攻。這將增加你奪得「最後致命一擊」的機率！$

segment.source: Compare the performance of the B-wing with that of the X-wing in this recreation of the initial attack against the Death Star's surface.
segment.target: 在此重現對死星表面的 首波進攻任務中， 比較 B翼戰機與 X翼戰機的作戰表現。

segment.source: Engage any TIE Fighters encountered on your way to the [[Nav Buoy]].
segment.target: 在前往[[導航浮標]]途中，迎擊遭遇的所有鈦戰機。

segment.source: Destroy all [[Turbolaser Gun Towers]] within 2 kilometers of the [[Nav Buoy]].
segment.target: 摧毀[[導航浮標]]方圓 2 公里內的所有[[渦輪雷射砲防禦塔]]。

segment.source: Destroy all [[Hangar Ports]] from which the TIE Fighters are launched.
segment.target: 摧毀所有出動鈦戰機的[[機庫出入口]]。

segment.source: What if the B-wing had been available at the Battle of Yavin?$ The Death Star surface is covered with [[Turbolaser Towers]]. These batteries provide defense against small spacecraft such as starfighters. The Death Star also carries a large contingent of [[TIE Fighters]] and [[Bombers]]. Both of these forces must be countered before we can launch our assault on the [[Death Star's Trench]].$
segment.target: 若在雅汶戰役中已有 B翼戰機能夠參戰，戰況會如何？$死星表面布滿了[[渦輪雷射塔]]。這些防空砲臺專門用於防範星際戰機等小型艦艇。死星內部亦搭載了大量[[鈦戰機]]與[[轟炸機]]部隊。在我們向[[死星壕溝]]發起總攻擊前，必須先徹底壓制這兩股防禦火力。$

segment.source: Your mission is to rendezvous at the Nav Buoy and destroy all the Turbolaser Towers within a [[two]] kilometers radius. You must also destroy the four[[ Hangar Port exits]] that are camouflaged as simple supply containers. From here, TIE squadrons exit the interior of the Death Star.$$>Good Luck!$ $>May the Force be with you!
segment.target: 你的任務是在導航浮標處會合，並摧毀[[兩公里]]半徑內的所有渦輪雷射塔。你還必須摧毀偽裝成普通補給貨櫃的四個[[機庫出入口]]。鈦戰機中隊正是從此處湧出死星內部。$$>祝你好運！$ $>願原力與你同在！

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will clear the Death Star's defenses near this Nav Buoy.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將清理該導航浮標附近的死星防禦工事。

segment.source: Scroll through the target list to the 1st CON and assign it to memory (Shift-F5). Assign the other three to memory locations, also.$ Order your wingman to engage the nearest enemy while you attack the 1st CON. Use 3 torpedoes.$ Proceed to the 2nd, then the 4th, and finally the 3rd. Destroy each with 3 torpedoes.$ Break off to dogfight only when absolutely necessary.
segment.target: 滾動目標清單至第一個貨櫃（CON）並將其存入記憶槽（Shift-F5）。將其餘三個也同樣設定存入。$命令你的僚機迎戰最近的敵機，同時你全速攻擊第一個貨櫃。發射 3 枚魚雷。$依序攻擊第二個、第四個，最後攻擊第三個。各以 3 枚魚雷摧毀。$僅在萬不得已時才脫離進行空戰纏鬥。
鈦式截擊機 德爾塔
鈦式截擊機 德爾塔

segment.source: All TIE fighter hangar ports destroyed in target area
segment.target: 目標區域內所有鈦戰機機庫出入口均已摧毀

segment.source: All laser towers cleared in target area
segment.target: 目標區域內所有雷射防禦塔均已清除完畢

segment.source: Relive the climactic moment of the Battle of Yavin as you pilot your B-wing in the harrowing Trench Run!
segment.target: 重溫雅汶戰役的 高潮巔峰時刻， 駕駛 B翼戰機親歷 驚心動魄的壕溝突擊！

segment.source: In your[[ ]]B-wing follow the [[Nav Buoys]] to the Death Star Trench.
segment.target: 駕駛你的 B翼戰機沿著[[導航浮標]]進入死星壕溝。

segment.source: Turn [[left]] and [[descend]] into the Death Star Trench.
segment.target: 向[[左]]轉並[[俯衝]]切入死星壕溝。

segment.source: Beware of Imperial [[TIE fighters]]. They will send their best after you.
segment.target: 警惕帝國[[鈦戰機]]。敵方將派出最精銳的部隊攔截你。

segment.source: Follow the trench to the[[ Exhaust Port]]. Use your [[Proton Torpedoes]]!
segment.target: 沿著壕溝全速衝刺直至[[散熱排氣孔]]。發射你的[[質子魚雷]]！

segment.source: This mission looks again at the [[Battle of Yavin]]. How well suited would a B-wing have been for the crucial Death Star Trench Run? With almost as much speed as an X-wing and considerably better armor and shields, it seems the B-wing would have been ideally suited to the task!$ As you know, Alliance scientists and engineers had analyzed the captured technical readouts of the Death Star and discovered its [[weak spot]].
segment.target: 本次任務再度重溫[[雅汶戰役]]。B翼戰機在至關重要的死星壕溝衝刺中表現將會如何？憑藉幾乎媲美 X翼戰機的航速，以及遠為厚重的裝甲與強大護盾，B翼戰機顯然是勝任此項極限任務的夢幻利器！$正如你所知，同盟科學家與工程師解析了獲取的死星技術藍圖，發現了其唯一的[[致命弱點]]。

segment.source: The Death Star proved to be vulnerable through an [[exhaust outlet port]] located in an equatorial trench on the battle station's surface. A[[ proton torpedo]] fired directly into this exhaust port would cause a [[chain reaction]] in the artificial moon's reactor core that would destroy the entire Death Star.$ This daring attack would be made by a single starfighter in the hands of an exceptionally courageous pilot!
segment.target: 死星被證實存在一處位於太空站赤道壕溝中的[[散熱排氣孔]]致命缺口。一枚直接射入該排氣孔的[[質子魚雷]]，將在這座人造月球的反應爐核心引發劇烈[[連鎖反應]]，徹底摧毀整座死星。$這項大膽絕倫的致命一擊，將由一位勇氣非凡的王牌飛行員單機完成！

segment.source: Follow the Nav Buoys to the trench, turn left and dive down into it. Your B-wing's engines have been modified to triple their thrust. Your ship's computer will boost their output once you are in the trench.$ The exhaust port is located at the end of the trench. Watch your [[targeting computer]] for when the exhaust port comes into range of your proton torpedoes.$>May the Force be with you!
segment.target: 沿著導航浮標切入壕溝，左轉並向下俯衝扎入壕溝深處。你的 B翼引擎已改裝為三倍推力，一旦進入壕溝，艦載電腦將自動全力提升推力輸出。$排氣孔位於壕溝末端。緊盯你的[[目標鎖定電腦]]，待排氣孔進入質子魚雷射程時果斷開火。$>願原力與你同在！

segment.source: $>STRATEGY AND TACTICS$>FOR COMPLETING THIS MISSION$>ARE AVAILABLE.$$$>DO NOT READ IF YOU WISH TO$>DISCOVER THESE FOR YOURSELF!$$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: $>本任務已提供$>過關戰略與戰術建議。$$$>若你想親自探索破關之道，$>請勿閱讀以下內容！$$$>點擊黑色頁碼方塊$>即可查看提示內容。

segment.source: Set cannon recharge rate to full, and engage T/F Alpha. Once they're destroyed, set the shield recharge to full and head for the trench.$ Cannons and shields should be fully charged when you reach the trench. Redirect all energy to the engines for the dive into the trench. Reset cannons to full recharge and set shields all forward. As you close on the exhaust port, transfer cannon energy to the (forward) shields.
segment.target: 將雷射砲充能調至全滿，迎擊鈦戰機阿爾法（T/F Alpha）。一旦將其消滅，立即將護盾充能調至全滿並全速切向壕溝。$抵達壕溝時雷射與護盾應已滿格。在扎入壕溝瞬間將所有動力轉至引擎。重設雷射為全充能，並將護盾全部導向前向。接近排氣孔時，將雷射能量轉充至（前向）護盾。

segment.source: You've hit the exhaust port, that was one in a BILLION!
segment.target: 你命中了散熱排氣孔！那真是十億分之一的奇蹟一擊！

segment.source: RED ONE, GET OUT OF THERE!
